{
IntPtr p_data = handle_data.AddrOfPinnedObject();
CudaException.ThrowIfError(CudaDriverApi.cuMemcpyHtoD_v2(d_data, p_data, data_size));
}
finally
{
handle_data.Free();
}
}
kernelParams[0] = &d_data;
CudaException.ThrowIfError(CudaDriverApi.cuLaunchCooperativeKernel(
hfunc,
gridDimX, gridDimY, gridDimZ, // Grid dim
blockDimX, blockDimY, blockDimZ, // Block dim
sharedMemBytes, // Shared mem
IntPtr.Zero, // Stream
kernelParams
));
// Copy back array: data
if(data_size>0&&d_data!=IntPtr.Zero)
{
System.Runtime.InteropServices.GCHandle handleBack_data = System.Runtime.InteropServices.GCHandle.Alloc(data, System.Runtime.InteropServices.GCHandleType.Pinned);
try
{
IntPtr p_data = handleBack_data.AddrOfPinnedObject();
CudaException.ThrowIfError(CudaDriverApi.cuMemcpyDtoH_v2(p_data, d_data, data_size));
}
finally
{
handleBack_data.Free();
}
}
}
finally
{
if (d_data != IntPtr.Zero) CudaDriverApi.cuMemFree_v2(d_data);
}
}
public static unsafe void Launch_CooperativePhysicsProcess_Device(IntPtr data, uint gridDimX = 1, uint gridDimY = 1, uint gridDimZ = 1, uint blockDimX = 1, uint blockDimY = 1, uint blockDimZ = 1, uint sharedMemBytes = 0, System.Collections.Generic.Dictionary<string, string>? macros = null)
{
using var _cudaCtxScope = new global::Kassyi.GSharp.Runtime.Jit.JitEngine.CudaContextScope();
IntPtr hfunc = global::Kassyi.GSharp.Runtime.Jit.JitEngine.GetOrCompileKernel("CooperativePhysicsProcess", CooperativePhysicsProcess_CudaSource, null, macros);
try
{
void** kernelParams = stackalloc void*[1];
// Marshal device array: data
kernelParams[0] = &data;
CudaException.ThrowIfError(CudaDriverApi.cuLaunchCooperativeKernel(
hfunc,
gridDimX, gridDimY, gridDimZ, // Grid dim
blockDimX, blockDimY, blockDimZ, // Block dim
sharedMemBytes, // Shared mem
IntPtr.Zero, // Stream
kernelParams
));
}
finally
{
}
}
}
